SELECT sales_2022, sales_2023, 100 * (CAST(sales_2023 AS DOUBLE) - sales_2022) / sales_2022 AS pct_change FROM (SELECT COUNT_IF(YEAR(date) = 2022) AS sales_2022, COUNT_IF(YEAR(date) = 2023) AS sales_2023 FROM ANALYTICS.UK.UK_PRICE_PAID WHERE YEAR(date) IN (2022, 2023)) AS s
